checks.scopedFinalValidation: After the last birth-date feedback consolidation, typecheck, lint, server/static builds, controls, layout, journey, grouped intake, UX and local final browser checks were rerun; unaffected role, urgent-motion and API checks retain the passing results from this release.

features: Positive critical answer immediately opens a modal with tel:115, dispatcher script, brief safe guidance, correction or return actions; no early payment banner or document reflow
Active symptom and historical corrected-alert home states are distinct; helper is reopenable; only editable records offer correction and context derives from current member answers

Optional external hospital search uses chosen city, or approximate current coordinates after explicit browser permission; no background map requests, recorded location, or verified-nearest/clinical-capacity claims

Critical snapshots are captured before waiting for an in-flight save, retained after failures, retried with current credentials/version, and persisted before rapid corrections; clinician gate is preserved
Fixed feedback rows, full-message dialog, stable form validation/options/ticks, six-row calendar, stable search/map/file/payment feedback, and reserved image-viewer controls
Blue consent/home canvas motion floats on white without navy enclosure; live frame movement, pause, reduced motion and offscreen suspension verified
Canonical font preloads avoid duplicate font downloads; optional font display avoids late webfont substitution; initial identity and metadata hydrate before interactive views

Continuous white page canvas; enclosing discovery/intake/consent card border, radius and shadow removed; fixed actions integrated into full-width page footer with field grid and control affordances preserved
Established blue palette across canvas/SVG graphics, icons, controls, status surfaces and showcase
Full-width arrival banner and responsive member workspace; grouped desktop grids and narrow-screen layouts
All profile fields together; 15 clinical questions in 3 groups; contextual questions grouped with preserved legacy cursor
Fixed action bar with stable placement through validation; focused mobile input scrolls clear of bar
Doctor actionable metric filters, list/detail, information/decision/tracking panes, explicit request-information and publication controls
Coordinator queue and stage-specific contact/confirmation/completion controls; member receives persisted team result
Admin metrics open member, support and unresolved-payment queues; resolved response editing preserves resolution
Failed case switch clears selection so new record data cannot be acted on with an older selected member ID
Five current role architecture diagrams with interactive viewer, role tabs, downloads and handoff boundaries
Focused welcome, six visit reasons, user-selected goals, compact linked consent and progressive member panel preserved
Calm waiting states, unified member program actions and team-owned completion preserved
Motion supports pause/reduced motion and offscreen suspension; no outer focus ring
Nine current synthetic screenshots, concise current guide, complete source/build archive and per-file manifest
limitations: Real Android/iPhone camera and GPS not tested
Home visits remain demo-only; production provider/retention agreements not implemented
City starter catalog is not a nationwide official dataset
Public site uses browser-local storage; no shared cross-device patient database
SMS, banking, provider appointment confirmation and live medical operation remain unconnected
Startup improvement verified with controlled delays, not measured on user network
Safari and Firefox not tested; no comprehensive security/load audit or clinical validation
Goals are reason-based conversation prompts, not validated disease-specific care targets
Comprehensive target user-flow includes future integrations; current implementation and role responsibilities are documented in WORKFLOW-ARCHITECTURE-v2.2-fa.md
Hospital search opens an external map; no verified in-app directory of nearest emergency facilities or live capacity is connected. Dispatcher guidance takes precedence.
Interaction geometry checks do not establish zero layout shift during every initial load, content expansion or future state; cold optional-font fallback may remain for a visit.

publicBrowser.reason: Chromium does not trust the environment proxy CA; automatic approval review rejected a persistent trust-store addition. TLS verification was not disabled. Public HTTPS byte comparison succeeded; browser behavior was tested locally.

baseline.scope: 78 individual API/calendar/UX/roles/edge/presentation/startup checks. These are historical baseline results, not rerun totals for 1.9.
